name: Immenstadt im Allgäu (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of green, white and green, charged at the centre with the city arms of Immenstadt im Allgäu (a fish and clover leaves on white and green).
history: Municipal flag of Immenstadt im Allgäu; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Immenstadt arms — fish and clover leaves
